offers.sn: At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. 40% of all food produced in the world is wasted.
offers.rq: In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in maintaining and enhancing our cloud-native IT environment, focusing on enhancing and automating our core systems to support our global team. Communication: You have excellent communication skills in English and can clearly explain complex technical concepts to non-technical colleagues.
